depends_on: Rosser-Schoenfeld 1962: p_k < k(ln k + ln ln k) for k >= 6
notes: Proved: q_{n+2} < 2 q_n for n >= 63 (M = p_{n+2} < 1.44 p_n by Nagura twice; p_M < 1.44m(ln 1.44m + lnln 1.44m) < 2 m ln m < 2 p_m for m >= 300), and direct check for n <= 1e5; only n = 1, 2, 3 fail. Outside Lean: everything (three cited explicit prime bounds, finite check, real estimate). Core: core-explicit-prime-bounds-lean.

sources.cite: J. Bayless, D. Klyve, T. Oliveira e Silva, New bounds and computations on prime-indexed primes, Integers 13 (2013) A43
sources.what: PIP bounds; triangle claim not found
